x-security-requirements: Validate Host and Origin; reject foreign browser origins and cross-site writes
No wildcard CORS; require application/json for JSON writes
Use subprocess argv, never interpolate user target into shell
Use existing known_hosts and never disable host-key verification
No credentials, raw transcripts or stack traces in error logs

get.description: 不阻塞等待所有 SSH 扫描。部分主机失败仍返回 200、缓存与 warnings。按实际活动滚动 7 天过滤；Read 且已证明完成超过 24 小时才隐藏。没有可靠活动时间的降级策略见 README；本草案保留并警告。
